stem: \[\frac{x}{2} + y = 7\] \[x - y = 5\] If \((x, y)\) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Add the equations to eliminate \(y\): \(\frac{x}{2} + x = 12\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
sol = solve([x/2 + y - 7, x - y - 5], [x, y])
assert sol == {x: 8, y: 3}
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [sol[x]]
